lesson.introText:
Hey guys! I’m BUDDY! Today, we’ll practice a melody that decides whether you are asking or confirming. It’s... …TAG QUESTIONS! The same tag means two different things: aren’t you?

A falling tag says: I know this and I only want you to agree. A rising tag says: I’m not sure at all, so please tell me the answer.
buddyBaloes: Hey guys! I’m BUDDY! Today, we’ll practice a melody that decides whether you are asking or confirming. It’s...

…TAG QUESTIONS!
The same tag means two different things:
aren’t you?
A falling tag says: I know this and I only want you to agree.
A rising tag says: I’m not sure at all, so please tell me the answer.

conversation.question: A: You follow that channel, don’t you? ↑
modelAnswers: B: I do, but I skip half of it.

conversation.question: A: That trend got old fast, didn’t it? ↓
modelAnswers: B: It lasted about two weeks.

conversation.question: A: You wouldn’t pay for that app, would you? ↑
modelAnswers: B: Only if it were really useful.

conversation.question: You spend hours online, don’t you? ↑
You follow a lot of people, don’t you? ↑
That trend was silly, wasn’t it? ↓
You’ve seen that video, haven’t you? ↑

You don’t watch TV anymore, do you? ↑

evaluation.question: Which tag melody is harder for you? Why?
